full_prompt_en: A square close portrait presents an adult man facing the viewer from the center of a nearly black background. His eyes meet the camera steadily, and his mouth is closed beneath a short dark mustache and beard. Weathered skin is modeled by warm, low light: the forehead and nose receive the clearest illumination, while the sides of the face recede into brown shadow. Faint reddish marks sit on both cheeks. A close-fitting rounded cap covers the crown of his head. It is densely embroidered with narrow geometric bands in aged red, green, tan, and dark blue, and a small central vertical division sits above his brow. Long pale feathers radiate from behind the cap, reaching outward and beyond the top edge; darker quills and a few red accents interrupt their fan. Strands of pale fur and braided cords frame the face at either side. Multiple rows of small beads and textured necklaces gather around the neck and across the upper chest. The dark garment beneath them is only partly visible, with patterned trim and worn-looking fabric emerging from shadow. The framing is tight enough that the elaborate headwear and layered adornment nearly fill the square, leaving little empty space except the black recesses between feathers. The lighting is controlled and subdued rather than bright; tiny highlights pick out beads, individual barbs, stitching, and facial planes against the deep background. Earthy colors dominate, with muted red and teal details supplying restrained contrast. The whole image has the tactile weight of a staged, painterly photograph, balancing exact surface detail with a solemn, still gaze. No readable text appears.
full_prompt_zh: 方形近景肖像中，一位成年男子从几乎黑色的背景中央正面望向观者。目光稳定，嘴唇闭合，唇边和下巴有短而深的胡须。温暖低照度光刻画出略显风霜的皮肤：前额与鼻梁最明亮，脸的两侧退入棕色阴影。双颊可见淡淡红色痕迹。圆弧形贴头帽覆盖头顶，其表面密布暗红、绿色、浅棕和深蓝的狭窄几何刺绣带，眉心上方有竖向中心分界。长而浅色的羽毛从帽后放射，向两边和画面顶缘之外伸出；较暗的羽轴和少量红色点缀打断羽扇。浅色毛束与编绳从两侧围住面部。多排细小珠串和有纹理的项饰聚在颈部，横过上胸。其下深色服装只露出部分，带花纹的滚边和仿佛磨旧的布料从阴影中浮现。画框紧得让繁复头饰和层叠装饰几乎填满方形，除了羽毛间黑色缝隙，留白很少。照明受控而低沉，细小亮点从深背景中勾出珠子、羽枝、缝线和面部平面。土色占主导，低饱和红与蓝绿提供克制对比。整幅影像具有摆拍的绘画感与可触的重量，以精确表面细节和肃穆静止的目光相平衡。没有可读文字。
style_prompt_en: Dark, painterly photographic realism concentrates soft low-key light on a central face or form while the surrounding field falls nearly to black. Densely layered organic textures and fine decorative lines remain individually legible where the light catches them, then merge into shadow toward the edges. Radial shapes create a broad crown around a compact vertical center, and close cropping gives ornament a full-frame presence. A muted palette of umber, bone, charcoal, aged red, and restrained blue-green avoids glossy saturation. Subtle grain and worn surfaces lend a tactile, historical atmosphere. The effect is solemn and still, with precise highlights carrying detail through a deep, enclosing darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 深暗的绘画感摄影写实把柔和低调光集中在中央面部或形体上，周围场域几乎落入黑色。密集叠置的有机肌理与细装饰线在光照处仍可逐一辨认，到边缘渐渐并入阴影。放射形体在紧凑竖向中心周围形成宽阔冠状轮廓，近距离裁切令装饰充满画框。赭棕、骨白、炭黑、陈旧红与克制的蓝绿组成低饱和配色，没有光亮艳色。细微颗粒与磨旧表面赋予可触的历史气息。整体肃穆静止，由精确亮点在深而围合的黑暗中托起细节。
theme_en: A solemn man in a richly feathered ceremonial headdress
theme_zh: 一位戴繁复羽饰头冠的肃穆男子
name: Jimmy Nelson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
